name: cashbox-cloud
description: CashBox Cloud - Railway-ready Next.js frontend with local Express/Prisma backend

scripts.railway:install: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run railway:install && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: node --check scripts/start.js && npm --prefix backend run check
